dogecoin.text: Many of my friends have been telling me that they’ve bought Dogecoin. But when I ask them what other cryptos they own, they say none. This has me worried.

I’m watching a podcast with the Dogecoin Millionaire and I can’t help but think of how reckless his investment/gamble strategy is. 

Both his credit cards are maxed out and his bank account has a negative balance of $5,400.
